title: Four Color #1001 Lowell Thomas High Adventure Dell 1959 Photo Cover Silver Age
conditionDescription: Light spine and edge wear, some toning, back cover lightly soiled. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
descriptionText:
Dell Four Color #1001 -- Lowell Thomas' High Adventure (Aug-Oct 1959, Dell Publishing). Photo cover with Lowell Thomas; "Africa: Pygmies and hippo hunting!" Based on the Lowell Thomas TV specials, with the Australian Outback and Mountains of the Moon stories. Back cover "Australian Aboriginal Weapons" feature. Cover price 10c ("Still 10c").

Condition: Very Good. Cover bright with light spine and edge wear, some toning; back cover toned with light soiling. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
